## What's changed

- Added opt-in stream-container negotiation for native television players such as Tater Tube Player for Apple TV.
- Repackages otherwise compatible local media into an MPEG transport stream when AVKit cannot open the source container, without re-encoding compatible video or audio tracks.
- Emits Apple TV-compatible MPEG transport streams when only the audio or video track needs conversion, preserving the compatible track whenever possible.
- Keeps existing Steam and retro players on their current playback paths unless a player explicitly requests the new output container.
